name: Skribbl Arena
tagline: Draw the word, race the clock, guess before everyone else.
description: One player draws a secret word while everyone else guesses in chat. Fastest guessers score big, the drawer earns points from every correct guess.

name: Copycat Challenge
tagline: Memorize a masterpiece, then draw it from memory.
description: A famous painting flashes for five seconds. Then everyone draws it from memory on their own private canvas and votes on the best (and funniest) results.

name: Draw the Lyric
tagline: Draw the lyric, everyone else guesses the song.
description: One player sees a song lyric and draws it on the shared canvas. Everyone else races to name the song title before the timer runs out.

name: One Line, One Shape
tagline: Draw it in one continuous line. Lift the pen and lose time.
description: Draw an object without ever lifting the pen. Break the line and the clock punishes you, guessers still have to figure out what it is.

name: Shadow Sketch
tagline: Fill in the silhouette, guessers only see your strokes.
description: The drawer sees a faint silhouette and must sketch the details that make it recognizable. Guessers watch the drawing appear with no silhouette to help them.

name: Would You Rather
tagline: Tough choices. Live percentages. Zero wrong answers.
description: Answer outrageous dilemmas in real time and watch the percentages swing as the room votes. Submit your own dilemmas to the queue.

name: Most Likely To…
tagline: Vote for who in the room would actually do it.
description: A scenario appears and everyone votes for the player most likely to survive it, cause it, or star in it. Results rank the room from most to least guilty.

name: Never Have I Ever
tagline: Confess, vote, and find out who's the wildest in the room.
description: Players take turns confessing things they've never done while everyone votes I HAVE or I HAVE NOT. Running tallies crown the most innocent and the most chaotic.

name: This or That
tagline: Rapid-fire pairs. Tap your side. Ride the herd.
description: Twenty lightning-fast comparisons in two minutes. Vote instantly, watch live bars swing, and build a streak when your pick matches the majority.

name: Rhyme or Crime
tagline: A word that rhymes AND fits the category. Sounds easy.
description: Match the prompt word with a rhyme that fits the category, a fruit that rhymes with 'witch'? Peach. Five rounds, streaks, and speed bonuses.

name: Emoji Plot
tagline: Decode movies and books from emoji sequences.
description: 👦⚡🧙🏰, Harry Potter. Ten emoji movie and book plots to decode, with progressive hints and a create-your-own mode to challenge friends.

name: Timeline Tussle
tagline: Drag three historical events into the right order.
description: Three shuffled events, one correct order. Score big for perfect chronology, half for a single swapped pair, and learn something either way.

name: Price Is Right
tagline: Guess the price. Don't go over. Get rich in bragging rights.
description: Real product, real price, zero shopping. Guess within range on five weird, luxury, and everyday items, exact guesses are worth double.

name: Genre Swap
description: Harry Potter as a gritty crime thriller? Ten swapped-genre movie descriptions to identify against the clock.

name: Genre-Bender
tagline: Rap lyrics rewritten as Shakespearean sonnets.
description: Identify the song behind a sonnet-ified banger. Ten 'bended' lyrics with optional BPM and year clues for the truly stuck.

name: Charades
tagline: Act it out. Pass the phone. Keep the streak alive.
description: The classic party game, digitized. Hollywood or Bollywood titles, a 60-second timer, and a pass-the-phone flow built for co-located play.

name: Guess Who? Celebrity Edition
tagline: Twenty yes/no questions to name the secret celebrity.
description: One player holds a secret celebrity. Everyone else asks yes/no questions, alive? actor?, and races to name them before the 20-question reveal.

name: Trivia
tagline: Solo daily challenges or a room-wide quiz race.
description: 525 questions across ten categories. Play the daily trivia solo or race the room, 10 points per correct answer.

name: Daily Sudoku
tagline: The same seeded sudoku for everyone, every day.
description: A fresh sudoku puzzle every day, seeded by date so everyone plays the same grid. Tap to place numbers, finish the grid, and race the daily leaderboard.
